verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a self-hosted Git service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or a switch to disable either. The general 'full control' self-hosting claim and the admin/app.ini configuration mechanism are adjacent and do not document a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
